summary: Phase 2 backend testing complete. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_profile_location_reviews.py with 32 tests covering profile CRUD (with role-specific validation for Doctor/Patient/Pharmacy/Engineer), location + GeoJSON 2dsphere nearby search, and reviews with role-pair rules. All 32 Phase 2 tests pass plus 20 iteration-1 regression tests = 52/52 passing. The 'Pharmacist'->'Pharmacy' rename works correctly. Seeded pharmacy@test.com / Pharmacy123! since old pharmacist@test.com still holds user_type='Pharmacist'.

minor.issue: Role-rule check (line 517-522) executes BEFORE the self-review check (line 524-525). Means the 'Cannot review yourself' 400 branch is unreachable for any user — patient reviewing self returns 403 (Patient->Patient not in ALLOWED_REVIEW_PAIRS) instead of 400. Either reorder (check self first) or document expected behavior.

Legacy users created before Phase 2 (e.g. doctor@test.com from iteration 1) do not have a 'profile_data' field in DB. GET returns the document without defaulting profile_data to {}. Consider returning {**user_doc, 'profile_data': user_doc.get('profile_data') or {}} for consistency.

Public profile correctly hides 'email' but still exposes 'phone' (which is PII) and full 'profile_data' (which for Patient contains age, gender, blood_type, chronic_illnesses — PHI). Consider stripping phone and gating sensitive patient profile fields.

Creates the 2dsphere index on every call inside the request handler (line 459). Should be created once at app startup. Also no validation on radius_km (negative or huge values accepted), no pagination beyond hardcoded .to_list(50).

action_items: (LOW) In POST /api/reviews, move the self-review check above the role-pair check, or remove the 400 self check since it's currently dead code.
(LOW) In GET /api/profile, default missing 'profile_data' to {} so frontend doesn't have to defensively handle absence (legacy users).

(MEDIUM) Privacy: GET /api/profile/{user_id} (public) should exclude 'phone' and probably hide Patient profile_data (PHI). Currently any authenticated user can read any Patient's age/blood_type/chronic_illnesses.
(LOW) Move db.locations.create_index([('location', '2dsphere')]) from inside /nearby into app startup; validate radius_km > 0; add pagination params.

(LOW) /api/auth/register hardcodes profile_data={} but the User model has it Optional — keep consistent. Old pharmacist@test.com still holds user_type='Pharmacist' (now-invalid). Consider data migration or admin tool.
critical_code_review_comments: Dead code: 'Cannot review yourself' (HTTP 400) in POST /api/reviews is unreachable because the ALLOWED_REVIEW_PAIRS check runs first and no role can review its own type. Reorder checks.

PII leak risk: Public /api/profile/{user_id} returns 'phone' and full role-specific 'profile_data' including Patient PHI (age, gender, blood_type, chronic_illnesses). Only 'email' is stripped. Apply field-level redaction per user_type.
2dsphere index is created on every /nearby call (best-effort try/except). Should be an idempotent startup task. Also, no input validation on radius_km (could be 0 / negative / 1e9).
ALLOWED_REVIEW_PAIRS is fine but reviews allow multiple reviews from same reviewer to same reviewee (no upsert/dedupe). Consider unique (reviewer_id, reviewee_id) or 'one review per pair' policy.
No pagination on GET /reviews/user/{user_id} or /reviews/me (hardcoded .to_list(500)). Will not scale.
GET /api/profile/{user_id} doesn't 401 unauth — wait, it DOES require auth (Depends(get_current_user)). OK. But could allow anonymous access for public discovery.
Same heuristic from iteration 1 (token.startswith('test_session_') or len(token)>200) still present — fragile token-type detection.
Old user pharmacist@test.com still has user_type='Pharmacist' (invalid after rename). No migration script applied. New tests use pharmacy@test.com instead.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 endpoints (/profile, /location, /nearby, /reviews) all verified working. Author-only delete (403 otherwise). Tag aggregation in GET /reviews/user/{id} returns tag_counts dict + average_rating. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_profile_location_reviews.py.
rca_of_the_issue: No new bugs found. Two minor design observations: (1) The 400 'Cannot review yourself' branch is dead code because the role-pair check runs first and no role can review its own type — patient reviewing self hits 403 first. (2) Public /profile/{user_id} only strips email but still exposes phone + Patient PHI (age, blood_type, chronic_illnesses) to any authenticated user — potential privacy issue.
